notes.title: September Early Access Update! New days July 25-August 1
notes.notes: [p]We made it to August!! The game is now 2/3 complete, with the September Early Access update adding July 28 to August 1.[/p][p][b][u]Please remember to leave a review![/u][/b] This improves visibility for the game and feedback helps a lot![/p][p][/p][h3]Early Access v0.4 Changelog[/h3][list][*][p]Added in-game days July 25th to August 1st.[/p][list][*][p]This includes a pass on story branches, conditions, writing, backgrounds, music, and voice adlibs.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]8 new backgrounds: 8 dream scenes.[/p][/*][*][p]3 new characters and a rough sketch of their sprites.[/p][/*][*][p]More voice lines! From July 5th to July 23rd.[/p][/*][*][p]Added dust particle VFX for some of the dreams.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the content warnings to be a bit more specific.[/p][/*][*][p]June 28th: If the dream is repeated, it starts after the second "wake up" so it's less long and repetitive.[/p][/*][*][p]July 11th to July 26th: Adjusted the relationship pacing.[/p][/*][*][p]July 26th and 27th: Updated expressions and adlibs.[/p][/*][*][p]UI: Semi-opaque text box on in-game gallery image moments is now the default.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Two weeks since launch!
notes.notes: [p]It's been almost two weeks since I've launched DEVIL'S LIMINAL in Early Access! Thank you so much for the support, reviews, and screenshots! I'm glad people are enjoying the writing and characters so much. I really appreciate the feedback.[/p][p][/p][p]Tentatively, I'm planning to have another update later this month! [/p][p][/p][p]Some things to look forward to:[/p][list][*][p]An unusual board game night. [/p][/*][*][p]The tension at home coming to a head. [/p][/*][*][p]Meeting two more characters. [/p][/*][*][p]A weekend away for a concert. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Please remember to leave a review![/b] As a new developer, reviews are crucial for the visibility of the game! And since this is an Early Access game, reviews let me know what you think so far![/p]

notes.title: Demo update, release plans, and studio update!
notes.notes:
You may have noticed DEVIL'S LIMINAL is now being released by Studio Interlude. I'm a solo developer, and this year I have officially formed my own studio so that I may work on finishing DEVIL'S LIMINAL full-time. 

Pretty soon I'll have some more updates about the final game, so please wishlist and follow the studio! By wishlisting the game, you directly help with the visibility and success of the game.

[b]I've set up a [url=https://www.patreon.com/studiointerlude]Patreon[/url], [url=https://ko-fi.com/studiointerlude]Ko-fi[/url], and [url=https://studiointerlude.kit.com/]newsletter[/url]. As a subscriber, there's some goodies you'll get to see first. [/b]

In the meanwhile, the demo has a few updates:
[list]
[*] The demo is now called "Extended Demo" instead of "Chapter 2".
[*] An option for text boxes on gallery scenes to be either transparent or semi-transparent.
[*] Credits have been updated with the new studio name, Studio Interlude!
[/list]
[b]Please wishlist the game, and check out the demo! It covers 1/3rd of the full game, including the start of your relationship with Bec or Clara.[/b]

Thank you for your support, and please enjoy the demo!

notes.title: Chapter 2 added to the Demo!
notes.notes:
Chapter 2 has been added to the demo!

The new content features:
[list]
[*] 1-2 additional hours of gameplay
[*] The story now continues to July 4th
[*] Confessions!
[*] New art and voice acting.
[*] A new character's introduction
[/list]

Please keep in mind the game is still in-development and will have some bugs and unpolished sections.
